snippet.title: Mantis Shrimp Evolution: Spear or Hammer?
snippet.description:
One mantis shrimp has a spear. Another has a hammer. Both are built from the same basic front pair of hunting limbs.

This paper-diorama short follows how those limbs changed across different lineages: a slender, spined tip for piercing in spearers, and a thickened striking club in smashers.
